name: copilot-insights-project
description: Select the project for this VS Code window and attribute its native Copilot telemetry to that project.

commands.title: Copilot Insights: Reload for Project Change

copilotInsights.endpoint.description: Insights service origin, not the OTLP endpoint. Local mode requires loopback. Endpoint changes require a window reload.

copilotInsights.authentication.description: Local evaluation has no authentication. Production requires HTTPS and an Entra Insights.Publisher assignment.

copilotInsights.tenantId.description: Production Entra tenant GUID. Never read from the workspace project file.

copilotInsights.clientId.description: Entra public-client app registration authorized for the Context.Publish delegated permission.

copilotInsights.apiAudience.description: Insights API app registration client ID, not the portal client ID.
